info.title: Arena API
info.description: Fictional API for a docs-as-code demo. This file is the source of truth that the docs are checked against.

placement.description: Final position, starting at 1. Players can share a placement to record a draw. Placements do not have to be consecutive.

results.description: One result for each player to place. The match returns them in placement order.

display_name.description: The player display name. Can be missing if the player no longer exists.
